title: Short Circuit & Fuse
guideNormal: Normal load — current stays below the fuse rating and the load stays powered.
guideShort: Short circuit — current spikes. If it exceeds the rating, the fuse blows.
guideBlown: Fuse open — the path is broken until you replace the fuse.
conditionsHint: A short bypasses the load. High current melts the fuse and opens the circuit.
quizQuestion: A fuse protects a circuit by…
quizCorrect: Melting / opening when current is too high
quizWrong: Increasing voltage to stop the short
learnMore: Fuses are sacrificial safety devices: they open when current exceeds their rating.
